options.name: city_locality
options.description: City or Locality. Maximum length of 128 alpha-numeric characters. Special characters '', '#' and '$' are not allowed.

options.name: common_name
options.description: Common name for which the certificate is to be generated. Maximum length of 64 alpha-numeric characters. Special characters '', '#' and '$' are not allowed.

options.name: country
options.description: Country code. Only two characters are allowed. Special characters are not allowed.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: organization
options.description: Name of the organization for which certificate is to be generated. Maximum length of 64 alpha-numeric characters. Special characters '', '#' and '$' are not allowed.

options.name: organization_unit
options.description: Section or Unit of the organization for which certificate is to be generated. Maximum length of 64 alpha-numeric characters. Special characters '', '#' and '$' are not allowed.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state_province
options.description: State or Province. Maximum length of 128 alpha-numeric characters. Special characters '', '#' and '$' are not allowed.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: valid_time
options.description: Requested validity days for the certificate. Value ranges from 1 to 3650 days.
